# Independent audit of the exact all-corner truncated-simplex theorem

Audited `candidate 3795aff5f3322d52`.

This audit independently checks the analytic all-normal proof, not just
its algebraic verifier.

1. At a simplex centroid, the classical equality directions are exactly
   the d+1 facet-parallel apex normals. Compactness of the sphere gives
   a positive cap-volume gap outside small neighborhoods of them.
   Joint continuity in point and normal preserves this gap uniformly
   in a sufficiently small point neighborhood. Each chosen normal
   neighborhood preserves strict included/excluded signs at ALL vertices.
   Thus its caps really isolate one vertex; no other sign pattern is
   silently discarded.

2. In the i-th vertex-cap chart, the coefficients a_j obey a_j>1 and
   sum a_j lambda_j(y)=1. AM--GM has the stated direction: it bounds
   the product a_j lambda_j from above, giving the volume product from
   below. The optimizer a_j=1/(d lambda_j(y)) is feasible near the
   centroid and tends to the canonical normal, hence remains inside
   the same neighborhood. This proves both the formula and attainment.

3. For truncated bodies, the canonical through-point caps give the
   bound on every barycentric coordinate of EVERY global maximizer.
   Since their sum is one, these upper bounds localize all coordinates
   near 1/(d+1). No symmetry or selected-optimizer convergence is used.
   Every cap changes by at most tV, so the outside-normal gap persists.
   On the compact remaining normal/point neighborhoods, coefficients
   a_j are uniformly bounded and bounded away from one. Thus an entire
   small i-corner is included and every other corner excluded. This
   justifies subtracting its WHOLE volume t_i in the local formula.

4. The scalar equation has derivative (d+1)^d in D at the undeformed
   point, so the stated local existence, uniqueness, and smoothness
   follow. Its substitution gives d^d product lambda_i*=c exactly.
   The weights w_i=1-d lambda_i* are positive, sum to one, and satisfy
   1-w_j=d lambda_j*. Consequently the weighted logarithmic sum equals
   d sum lambda_j* log(lambda_j/lambda_j*). Strict Jensen bounds it by
   zero and forces equality only at lambda=lambda*. This is a global
   optimizing certificate for the local product expression, not merely
   a first-order stationary condition. Combined with the localization
   of all global maximizers, it proves the claimed unique global optimum.

5. Zero individual truncations do not affect any denominator or compact
   normal argument. Dimension one is correctly separated, and closed
   cap boundaries have zero full-dimensional measure. The one-corner
   planar root and both variation coefficients agree with independent
   expansion of the displayed closed form. Oblique optimal caps are
   retained; replacing them by original facet-parallel caps would indeed
   give the wrong second-order term.

No correction is required. The same analytic argument also applies when
the removed sets have arbitrary shapes but remain in the same sufficiently
small vertex neighborhoods; that distinct extension is recorded in
`candidate f1516303d16df6d4`.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
